grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice ::= "{" space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-count-kv "," space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-scene-narrative-kv "," space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-visual-logic-kv "," space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-exclusions-kv "," space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-uncertainties-kv space "}"
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-count ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-count-kv ::= "\"count\"" space ":" space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-count
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-exclusions ::= "[" space (ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-exclusions-item ("," space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-exclusions-item){0,11})? space "]"
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-exclusions-item ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-exclusions-kv ::= "\"exclusions\"" space ":" space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-exclusions
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-scene-narrative ::= "\"" char{80} char* "\""
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-scene-narrative-kv ::= "\"scene_narrative\"" space ":" space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-scene-narrative
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-uncertainties ::= "[" space (ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-uncertainties-item ("," space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-uncertainties-item){0,5})? space "]"
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-uncertainties-item ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-uncertainties-kv ::= "\"uncertainties\"" space ":" space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-uncertainties
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-visual-logic ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-visual-logic-kv ::= "\"visual_logic\"" space ":" space ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice-visual-logic
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice ::= "{" space ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-target-kv "," space ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-reason-kv ( "," space ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-failure-risks-kv )? space "}"
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-failure-risks ::= "[" space (ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-failure-risks-item ("," space ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-failure-risks-item){0,2})? space "]"
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-failure-risks-item ::= "\"" char{3} char* "\""
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-failure-risks-kv ::= "\"failure_risks\"" space ":" space ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-failure-risks
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-reason ::= "\"" char{3} char* "\""
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-reason-kv ::= "\"reason\"" space ":" space ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-reason
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-target ::= ("\"newbie\"" | "\"illustrious\"" | "\"anima\"" | "\"z_image_turbo\"")
ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-target-kv ::= "\"target\"" space ":" space ref-defs-StartingModelChoice-target
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-picture-kv "," space response-format-schema-starting-choice-kv space "}"
response-format-schema-picture ::= ref-defs-ProsePictureChoice
response-format-schema-picture-kv ::= "\"picture\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-picture
response-format-schema-starting-choice ::= (response-format-schema-starting-choice-alternative-0 | response-format-schema-starting-choice-alternative-1)
response-format-schema-starting-choice-alternative-0 ::= ref-defs-StartingModelChoice
response-format-schema-starting-choice-alternative-1 ::= "null"
response-format-schema-starting-choice-kv ::= "\"starting_choice\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-starting-choice
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: New independent text-only same-return picture and method consumer; legacy models and assets retain their exact schemas
transformation.unchanged: Full schema identity, required wrapper fields, complete ProsePictureChoice fields, nested legacy method fields/defaults, nullable choices and all host bounds
transformation.method: Reuse the bounded review grammar derivation for only these three SHA-bound nested schemas; permit their exact nullable prose/start branches and bounded arrays
transformation.length_scope: Only string maxLength is omitted from sampler GBNF to avoid the installed 6703d7894 repetition parser boundary. String minLength and all array minItems/maxItems remain enforced by this grammar. The complete original schema, text system/prompt and host Pydantic retain every string maximum; overlong responses must be rejected without truncation or repair.
transformation.numeric_scope: Optional denoise retains 0 < value <= 1 and host default 0.25; sampler admits decimals without exponents
transformation.operation_scope: The new sampler excludes sketch without changing nested legacy schema enums; host validators also reject it and require picture for regenerate/handoff and null for keep/stop/local_edit
transformation.reference_scope: parent/child/neither remain bound reference choices, not user selection; host validates neither operation restrictions, live sources and actual capabilities
transformation.input_scope: Text-only complete artistic picture plus method decision; no visual permission, resource-admission change or dispatch authority
transformation.source_runtime_scope: Shared installed DLL diagnostic reference only; derivation is not a picture decision inference receipt and loads no model weights
